_doc: Bale automation and recycling stations at the base (automation/stations.gd). Costs: cubes + materials, paid once. Upgrades live in upgrades.json (tab hub): belt_speed, baler_speed, recycler_yield (bases in patch.json).

conveyor.name: Conveyor Feeder
conveyor.desc: A hopper pad and a powered belt into the scale. Drop bales on the pad; haulers use it when it is closer.

auto_baler.name: Auto-baler
auto_baler.desc: A hydraulic baling press dropped at the cleaning frontier. Cleaner robots tip their hoppers into it instead of baling on the spot; it presses denser bales for the haulers.

recycler.name: Recycler
recycler.desc: Shredder drums and a little smelter. Bales go in and never come back: out come bolts and clean building stock. Every bale burnt clean helps the sky.
